text: Planning a trip is half the fun for me. I spend weeks researching destinations, booking flights, and creating a loose itinerary. Once I arrive, the real adventure begins. I love immersing myself in new cultures, wandering through local markets, and trying street food I can't pronounce. However, language barriers can be tricky; sometimes I end up ordering something completely unexpected, but that's part of the charm. These experiences, from the confusing moments to the delicious surprises, create memories that last a lifetime. Each journey teaches me something new about the world—and about myself.
